reviews.comment: I can't recommend Professor Billings enough! She is the sweetest and makes it known she cares about her students. Her classes are straightforward and doable. I've taken her for 2 courses and I'd take her again if I could.

(Hlth 410) Professor Billings is a wonderful person and cares a lot about her students. She will not trick you, and is true to her word. Few professors like her at TAMU, so join her course quickly, you will not regret it. The only bad feeling I ever had in this course was when our class disappointed her (and because she awesome, it felt horrible)

I LOVE Professor Billings! I have taken her for 3 classes now (236, 481, & 410) & I cannot recommend her enough! Her grading is clear, her assignments are relevant but not over the top, and you can tell she actually cares about connecting with her students. I wish I could take every class she offers! She definitely deserves more recognition!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is truly so nice and caring! One of the best professors in the Health department. It is a writing intensive class everything must be turned in to pass, but she gives a very clear rubric and is not a tough grader at all. She makes going to class actually enjoyable and doesn't make the class stressful at all. Could not recommend her enough!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Billings is by far one of my fav profs at TAMU! She is so kind and caring, I want to be friends with her haha. She is funny, relatable and understands the strains of heavy work/reading/writing and tries to sympathize with us (moves deadlines, reduces word count, etc .) Couldn't rec her more, have taken her for the past 3-4 sems!

Professor Billings is super nice and funny. She responds very fast and provides good feedback. She only required us to go to Zoom meetings twice a week even though the class was supposed to meet three times a week. The textbook can be found online for free. I never really used my book because I felt like all of the info was covered in lecture.

Professor Billings cares so much about her students and about the material she teaches. For asynchronous HLTH 231, lectures are premade presentations from an online source and will have discussions (optional, but recommended) one day a week over the week's module.
